full_page.content:
1927, December 27
The following is the faithful transcription of the handwritten original message on a Seraphic Mass Association Card by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
James Molloy 10 A.M. Dec. 27, 1927
has been enrolled in the Mass Association
God Bless you James! Only keep up Courage and just, kiss the cross as Jesus offers it to you - God Bless you! Happy New Year! Fr. Solanus, Casey O.M. Cap.
Original in the Possession of : Sister Suzanne Molloy, I.H.M. 610 West Elm Avenue Monroe, MI. 48161
